newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity forms benefits outsourcing unit.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity forms benefits outsourcing unit.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Wednesday it formed a separate unit to offer benefits outsourcing, human resources and payroll administration and processing services to corporate clients.
The unit was formed by combining two previously separate Fidelity companies, which had already offered the services.
Fidelity said it named Jack Ferris, who was president of Fidelity Accounting and Custody Services, as president of the new unit. Robert Dwight was promoted to succeed Ferris.

Fidelity also said it has acquired for an undisclosed amount McQuade Inc, a 28-person consulting firm based in Framingham, Mass. The firm specializes in delivering actuarial and consulting services for retirement plan sponsors and will be combined with the new unit.
The McQuade acquisition allows Fidelity for the first time to offer actuarial and other consulting services related to retirement accounts and total benefits outsourcing.
